purpose: Reference-only drug-perturbation model (kept for comparison): ExPO exposure-aware model

sources.method: git clone <url> source/ && git -C source checkout <commit> && rm -rf source/.git

notes: Reference-only: published scope is 978 landmark genes only, so it fails the revised G1 gate. Absorbed from the deleted VALIDATION.md: `import expo` fails on a clean Python 3 because expo/models/expo_model.py contains a cp1252 en-dash (byte 0x96) at line 19; after converting that file to UTF-8 in a scratch copy, `python -m pytest tests/test_expo.py -q` gives 5 passed (imports, config, synthetic data, model instantiation, dataset creation at 20/100 genes). No pretrained weights are released.
